candidates.source_name: Trask (wearetrask.com / thetrask.com) — case studies & banking practice
candidates.why_relevant: Trask is the largest CZ-owned integrator embedded in Czech/Slovak retail banks (core banking, digital channels, PSD2/open banking, CRM). Its case-study and magazine content names bank clients (e.g. Komerční banka document platform, Slovenská sporiteľňa MS Dynamics CRM) that the banks themselves do not publicise, and reveals which sub-vendors and product stacks are used.
candidates.legal_status: public marketing content, copyright of publisher
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly crawl of case-study/reference/insight index pages; extract client name, project type, technology stack, year; also mirror the 'innovator' magazine PDFs.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query on integrator + banka + případová studie, then domain snowball
queries_used: Trask reference banka případová studie implementace

candidates.why_relevant: Adastra is the dominant data/BI integrator for CZ banks. Its Czech success-story pages name banks explicitly (Equa bank ODS + Adastra Banking Data Model, event-driven marketing in a leading Czech bank, Raiffeisenbank data platform), giving both project-level detail and the ABDM product footprint.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /cs/pripadove-studie/ and /cs/success-stories/* index; diff quarterly for new named-bank stories; parallel-crawl the /en/ tree since CZ and EN sets differ.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query, snowballed into per-story URLs
queries_used: Adastra reference banka případová studie data

candidates.source_name: Adastra CZ careers site — case-study section (jobs.adastra.cz)
candidates.why_relevant: Recruitment microsites reuse project descriptions that legal has scrubbed from the corporate site, and job ads name the exact bank technology stack being staffed (ABDM, Teradata, Informatica, core banking). A leading indicator of new bank programmes 3-9 months before delivery.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monthly scrape of case-study and open-position lists; keyword-extract product/vendor names and bank names.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs search surfaced the careers subdomain mirroring a corporate case study
queries_used: Adastra reference banka případová studie data

candidates.why_relevant: Profinit publishes named bank engagements (REMOS receivables monitoring for ČSOB; long-running BI/DWH programme at Komerční banka since 2005; Česká spořitelna, Raiffeisenbank listed as clients). Directly reveals risk/BI system ownership inside the four largest CZ banks.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl both /en/case-studies/ and the Czech /pripadove-studie/ tree plus /blog/ press releases; capture client, system name, start year.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query naming CZ banks, snowballed to vendor site
queries_used: Profinit reference banka případové studie ČSOB Komerční banka

candidates.why_relevant: Monet+ (Switchio) is the single most competitively relevant CZ actor for a payments vendor: it runs ČSOB's central transaction/authorisation system for 60k+ POS terminals and ~2M transactions/day, plus transport ticketing (open-loop EMV in ~20 CZ cities) and private/fleet card schemes. Reference pages state incumbency, scale and scheme coverage.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl /reference and /platby/reference-platby/ plus product pages (Retail Payments, Switchio); track added/removed logos as win/loss signal; snapshot for volume claims.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs seed query on card vendor + reference

candidates.source_name: Veřejný rejstřík a Sbírka listin (or.justice.cz) — filed financial statements and annual reports
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory filing archive: every CZ integrator (Trask Solutions a.s., Adastra, Profinit, Monet+, Cleverlance Enterprise Solutions, Aricoma Systems, GEM System, Asseco CE a.s. IČO 27074358) must deposit účetní závěrka and výroční zpráva. Gives audited revenue, headcount, related-party structure and sometimes segment/customer-concentration notes — the only non-marketing evidence of how big the bank business really is.
candidates.access_status: open_web, no login; PDF scans, some non-OCR
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Resolve IČO per target company, pull the Sbírka listin PDF list, download závěrky/výroční zprávy, OCR and parse revenue/EBIT/headcount into a time series; annual refresh (filings land ~mid-year for prior FY).
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs query on statutory filing obligation; first-principles 'who must publish'

negative_findings.description: STRV (CZ/US product studio) and Cetin / T-Mobile ICT services were named in the cell brief but no banking-sector reference, case study or client page for them surfaced in either Czech or English searches in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: No STRV banking case study and no CZ telco-ICT banking reference page located; only generic corporate pages appeared. Treat as not-yet-found, not as absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves a hole in the boutique-studio and telco-ICT delivery channels, both of which can hold bank digital-channel and infrastructure contracts.

negative_findings.description: The Czech phrase 'reference' and 'případová studie' are extremely noisy — searches for integrator+bank case studies return unrelated CRM vendors, moving companies (Stěhování KB), document-archiving vendors and student theses.
negative_findings.result_summary: Multiple queries returned mostly off-target domains (llpcrm.com, awigo.cz, easyproject.com, scribd copies) rather than the target integrators' own sites.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Recurring collection must query vendor domains directly (site-scoped) rather than relying on open web search, or precision will stay low.

negative_findings.description: Cleverlance Enterprise Solutions' own reference/case-study page URL was not directly surfaced; evidence of its bank work (multichannel banking, Česká spořitelna application design) came only via third-party press and encyclopaedia entries.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bank work is evidenced but the canonical vendor reference page was not identified in this pass; its content may now sit under the Aricoma domain after the group rebranding.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Cleverlance is one of the largest CZ suppliers of bank multichannel systems; missing its primary reference page understates the competitive picture.

negative_findings.description: No pass was made over LinkedIn company/employee pages, GitHub/technology-partner directories (e.g. Camunda, Temenos, Backbase, Microsoft partner finders) which list CZ implementation partners for named bank platforms.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: OEM partner directories are among the highest-yield pointer sources for identifying which CZ integrator implements which banking product.

negative_findings.description: or.justice.cz sbírka listin document retrieval typically requires session-bound navigation and serves scanned PDFs; automation feasibility was not tested here.
negative_findings.result_summary: URL and mechanism identified from documentation; no fetch attempted, so accessibility is a hypothesis.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The registry is the highest-credibility source in this cell; if the UI resists automation the dataor.justice.cz bulk feed or a mirror must carry the load.

coverage_gaps.description: Slovak and wider CEE arms of the same integrators (Asseco SK, Trask SK, Adastra SK/PL, Monet+ SK) were not covered; CZ banks are largely subsidiaries of Austrian/Belgian/French groups and projects are often contracted or referenced regionally.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the actor map to .sk/.pl/.hu domains of each cell actor and re-run the reference/case-study crawl in Slovak and Polish.

coverage_gaps.description: OEM/product-vendor partner directories (Camunda, Microsoft, SAP, Temenos, Diebold Nixdorf, Backbase, Salesforce) that list certified CZ implementation partners were not harvested.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Enumerate partner-finder pages for each banking product known to be in use in CZ and filter to Czech partners; this inverts the mapping from vendor->bank to product->integrator.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement channels were not searched: Registr smluv, Věstník veřejných zakázek and NEN reveal IT contracts with state-linked financial institutions (ČNB, ČMZRB/NRB, EGAP, ČEB, Česká pošta / Poštovní spořitelna perimeter).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query smlouvy.gov.cz and vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz for each integrator name to obtain contract values and dates — the only source giving priced, dated bank-adjacent deals.

coverage_gaps.description: Only current-state pages were sampled; historical reference pages that vendors have since removed (typical after an NDA complaint or a lost account) were not retrieved.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run Wayback Machine (web.archive.org) snapshots of each vendor's /reference and /pripadove-studie paths back ~10 years and diff — removed logos are a strong lost-account signal.

coverage_gaps.description: Czech-language coverage was achieved for all major actors, but CZ/EN site trees diverge: several vendors publish different reference subsets per language, and no Slovak-language querying was done at all.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Always crawl /cs/ and /en/ trees in parallel and add Slovak query variants ('referencie', 'prípadová štúdia', 'banka', 'platobné karty').

coverage_gaps.description: Financial-statement content was identified as a source type but no actual filing was retrieved or parsed, so revenue concentration on named bank clients remains unquantified for every actor in the cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Prioritise an ingest pass over sbírka listin PDFs for the top eight actors (Trask, Adastra, Profinit, Monet+, Cleverlance ES, Aricoma Systems, GEM System, Asseco CE) and build a revenue/headcount time series.

brief: The Czech integrator layer is an unusually generous indirect window into bank procurement: banks stay silent, but Trask, Adastra, Profinit, Monet+, GEM System and the Aricoma group all publish named-client case studies, and Kyndryl's newsroom disclosed the ČSOB Camunda BPM programme outright. Monet+ is the standout for a payments vendor — it publicly claims operation of ČSOB's central transaction/authorisation switch across 60k+ terminals and ~2M transactions a day, plus open-loop transit ticketing. Local-language search is not optional here: the Czech reference and case-study pages carry client detail the English pages omit, and Czech-only queries surfaced actors absent from the seed list (MoroSystems, FIDES, eppTec). The highest-value untapped layers are the statutory filings in sbírka listin / dataor.justice.cz for audited revenue concentration, and product-OEM partner directories plus Registr smluv, none of which were harvested in this pass.
